body: ac-03 SCOPED-PARTIAL: Rule 32 (value_sharpen, >50% schema-fail bar) demotes the three network-code columns (net/locationSource/magSource, 100% non-units) off measurement_unit -> categorical, removing 42,396 of 46,447 rejects. reject_rate_non_trivial 0.1494 (F) -> 0.0130 (C), non_trivial_pct 1.00. The remaining 0.0130 is the USGS event-id column ('id'), mislabeled geohash by the sibling head. It fails geohash only ~28% (alphabet) and 72% coincidentally satisfy base32, so it cannot be demoted by fail-rate without lowering the bar below real short-geohash fail (~23%, the deliberate v13 length floor). Demoting it is deferred to a model retrain (memory: earthquake-id-geohash-mislabel-retrain), not a pattern/Sharpen hack. Strict <=0.01 left unmet by author's call (keep v13 geohash precision guard).
